name: O'Meara Solar
old_description: Reduce, or eliminate, your monthly electric bills. We can design a system for your home that will meet your yearly usage needs, and save you money. With electricity rates rising around 2.5% per year, the fixed cost of a grid-tied solar PV system is a great investment for the future. With standard loan products available locally, a system can pay for itself in as little as ten years, and you can enjoy having very little if any electricity bills for at least the next 15 years
about:
O'Meara Solar is based in East Orange, Vermont. The company was founded as a father-son partnership between Darren O'Meara and Patrick O'Meara after they spent the better part of a decade installing, maintaining, and living with solar energy in their own homes and woodworking shop.

The firm designs, sells, installs, and services grid-tie, off-grid, and grid-tie-with-battery-backup solar photovoltaic systems. It also operates a solar-powered woodworking shop where it builds custom enclosures, cabinets, furniture, and built-ins using locally sustainably harvested wood. The company is commercially insured and draws on a network of master electricians and concrete professionals for structural work.

O'Meara Solar serves residential customers in Orange County, Vermont, and Grafton County, New Hampshire, as well as surrounding areas. Its off-grid systems are designed for remote homes and cabins, accommodating 120/240 V loads such as deep-well pumps and shop tools. The woodworking side produces custom pieces for the same regional clientele.

The business grew directly from the founders' personal off-grid lifestyle; Darren O'Meara holds a NABCEP Photovoltaic EL certification and handles electrical design, while Patrick O'Meara brings over thirty years of construction and fine woodworking experience. The company says this hands-on experience with the systems they sell is what sets its designs apart.
